title: Nengo releases: neuromorphic simulation software updates and benchmarks
summary: This GitHub page documents versioned releases of Nengo, a Python-based simulator for spiking neural networks used in neuromorphic engineering. The content lists specific feature additions across versions from 2.3.1 to 4.0.0, including support for new neuron types (e.g., RegularSpiking, PoissonSpiking), learning rules like Recursive Least Squares, and convolutional connections. Updates address compatibility with Python 3.8/3.9 and NumPy 1.19+, while removing legacy support. The releases detail bug fixes related to solver stability, simulation reset issues, and memory management for probes. Documentation updates include API references and example notebooks demonstrating model construction and function approximation.
tldr: Nengo GitHub release notes document software evolution of a neuromorphic simulator with new neuron models, learning rules, and Python compatibility updates between versions 2.3.1 and 4.0.0.
evidence: Added the ConvolutionTranspose transform to perform transposed convolution. It is commonly used for various forms of upsampling in deep networks.
Added the RLS (recursive least-squares) learning rule, which is an online version of the least-squares method typically used for offline decoder-solving.
